description:
Edit a finished ad creative in place. Only what the instruction
names changes; faces, layout, lettering and every other pixel are
kept, so you can chain edits (hair pink, then tail teal, then add a
sign) without the picture drifting. About 15 seconds. 3 credits; an
instruction that asks for a whole new look ("make it a comic",
"make it cinematic") repaints at 10. Returns the NEW run: poll get_run
until it is terminal and show the human the new image. Films are not
edited this way: re-render them with render_asset. Every earlier
version stays, so the human can go back to any of them.

instruction.description: What to change, in plain words: "make her hair pink", "swap the mug for a laptop", "fix the spelling of the headline". Name one or two changes; everything else stays.

run_id.description: A finished ad creative (painted still) to change: the run id from create_campaign, get_run or list_runs.

name: edit_asset
